name: Motivate Employees
steps: Lock the office door with the chain.
Use the shock device on the lazy worker.
Put the snack box on the center table.
Give the promotion certificate to the employee.
Put the cheerleader pompoms on the boss.
Bring the new colleague into the office.
Use the phone to order a folding bed.
Put cash bonuses on the desks.
Change the board to a tropical vacation.
Remove the uncooperative worker from the office.
